items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Function in Finite Support is Zero
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {h : α → M → N},
  Finsupp.sum 0 h = 0
items.informal_description: For any finite support function from $\alpha$ to a type $M$ with zero element, and for any function $h : \alpha \to M \to N$ where $N$ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum of the zero function (which maps all elements to zero) using $h$ is equal to the zero element of $N$. In symbols, $\sum 0 \, h = 0$.

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Element in DFinsupp is Zero
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {γ : Type w} {β : ι → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (β i)]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → (x : β i) → Decidable (x ≠ 0)] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid γ] {h : (i : ι) → β i → γ},
  DFinsupp.sum 0 h = 0
items.informal_description: The sum of the zero element in the type of dependent finite support functions, when mapped through any function to an additive commutative monoid, equals the zero element of that monoid. Formally, for any index type $\iota$, family of types $\beta(i)$, and additive commutative monoid $\gamma$, it holds that $\sum_{i \in \text{supp}(0)} h(i, 0(i)) = 0_\gamma$, where $0$ denotes the zero function in $\text{DFinsupp}$.

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Function Over Finite Support is Zero
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ M),
  (f.sum fun x x_1 => 0) = 0
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \alpha \to₀ M $ (where $ M $ has a zero element) and any additive commutative monoid $ N $, the sum of the zero element of $ N $ over the support of $ f $ is zero. That is, $ \sum_{x \in \text{support}(f)} 0 = 0 $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero over Finite Support Function is Zero
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {f : α →₀ M},
  (f.sum fun x x_1 => 0) = 0
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $f : \alpha \to₀ M$ and additive commutative monoid $N$, the sum of the zero element in $N$ over all terms of $f$ equals the zero element of $N$. Symbolically, $\sum_{f} 0 = 0$.

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Elements Over Support of Dependent Finite Support Function is Zero
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {γ : Type w} {β : ι → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (β i)]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → (x : β i) → Decidable (x ≠ 0)] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid γ] {f : Π₀ (i : ι), β i},
  (f.sum fun x x_1 => 0) = 0
items.informal_description: For any dependent finite support function $ f $ with values in a family of types $ \beta(i) $, the sum of the zero element of an additive commutative monoid $ \gamma $ over the support of $ f $ is equal to the zero element of $ \gamma $. Formally, $ \sum_{i \in \text{supp}(f)} 0 = 0 $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Terms in Dependent Finite Support Functions is Zero
items.informal_description: Let $ f $ be a dependent finite support function from an index type $ \iota $ to a family of types $ \beta(i) $, each equipped with a zero element. Let $ \gamma $ be an additive commutative monoid, and let $ h $ be a function assigning to each index $ i $ and element $ f(i) $ an element of $ \gamma $. If $ h(i, f(i)) = 0 $ for all $ i \in \iota $, then the sum of $ h(i, f(i)) $ over the support of $ f $ is zero.

items.informal_name: Finite Sum of Zeros in Additive Commutative Monoid
items.type: ∀ {M : Type u_2} {α : Sort u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M], ∑ᶠ (x : α), 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $ M $ and any type $ \alpha $, the finite sum of the zero element $ 0 \in M $ over all elements of $ \alpha $ is equal to $ 0 $. This holds because adding zero any number of times in a commutative monoid always yields zero.

items.informal_description: For any set $ s $ and additive commutative monoid $ M $, the finite sum $ \sum_{i \in s} 0 $ of the zero element in $ M $ over all elements $ i $ in $ s $ equals zero.
